title: Learning
intro: Which prompt slots go with better measured results. Compares posts that fill a slot against posts that leave it empty, per media type and objective. These are correlations from observed posts, not tested causes.

form.organizationIdsHelp: One organization, or several separated by commas for a pooled view.

idle: Enter at least one organization ID to run the report.
loadFailed: The learning report could not be loaded.
empty: No posts with a measured reward and structured prompt slots were found.

pooled.title: Pooled across organizations
pooled.description: These organizations have different audiences, so a gap can reflect who saw the posts rather than the prompt. Treat pooled verdicts as a weaker lead than a single-organization result.

truncated: The post limit was reached, so older posts were not read.
summary: {count, plural, one {# post read} other {# posts read}} across {organizations, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}}.
skipped: Left out: {noValidReward} without a valid reward, {noPrompt} without a stored prompt, {noSlots} with a prompt that predates structured slots.
note: Verdicts use an interval at the stated confidence level and are corrected for the number of comparisons. Rewards are scored against each post's own objective.
